integrity: The proof identifies every ideal with its coordinate support, proves the necessary-and-sufficient criterion for a two-ideal total dominating set, and derives the exact count by inclusion-exclusion. Exhaustive support enumeration for ranks two through seven is corroborative only. The 2013 algebra source lists 13A15 first in its Mathematics Subject Classification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to direct products of at least two fields and the standard intersection graph on nonzero proper ideals.
Nonfield local factors introduce additional ideals, so the support-only proof does not extend unchanged.
The field cardinalities are invisible to this invariant; the result depends only on the number of direct factors.
title: Minimum total and paired dominating sets in ideal-intersection graphs of products of fields
